jobs.description: "An empty fridge doesn't make anyone happy, right?" As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you make sure customers get their favorite snacks, breakfast and groceries delivered right to their door. On top of that, you’ll score an all-in hourly wage of €18.83. Ka-chinggg!With you behind the wheel, every delivery becomes a party! And you get paid well for it  too. With flexible working hours, almost anything is possible.Want to know more? Read on to check out the rest of the job opening!What we offer- A great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks- Standard 8.33% holiday allowance to do fun things- Plenty of holiday days for your well-deserved rest- Access to helpful training courses to keep growing- Freedom on the road with a truck full of goodies- Guaranteed pension accrual from your first workdayWho you areAs an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you deliver groceries right to the customer's front door. You are physically fit and have no problem lifting crates. You can also easily step in and out of the delivery van on a regular basis.In addition, you bring the following to the table:- You speak Dutch or English.- You have your own transportation to get to Heyderweg 2-6 in Leiden.- You hold a valid category B driver's license.What will you doFrom well-known cities to tiny villages you didn't even know existed: that is what awaits you as an Albert Heijn delivery driver. Every day is different. Some days your workday runs smoothly, and other days you run into obstacles—like an apartment building without an elevator or a house number that's nowhere to be found. You’ll experience it all.Fortunately, you are well-prepared during your onboarding period and you know how to keep a cool head! There are also plenty of opportunities to grow. For instance, you can quickly start working as a buddy, guiding and training new employees. Or you can become a plusser, making sure every driver hits the road fully equipped with all the essentials.- Working days:
